project.title: Office 365 Cloud Migration

parentsummary.deliverables: Managed the migration of email and collaboration services from on-premise Exchange to Office 365, encompassing Active Directory upgrades, tenant configuration, Exchange mailbox cutover, PowerShell automation, access control governance for the Exchange mail system, and decommission of legacy Exchange infrastructure across a multi-site organization shaped by mergers and acquisitions.
parentsummary.outcomes: Consolidated post-merger email infrastructure into a centralized Office 365 environment, reducing management risk, improving organizational collaboration, and delivering ISO:27001 and NIST-aligned access controls across the unified mail platform.

challenge.summary: The client intended to manage risk and centralize mail management into a streamlined cloud platform after growth through mergers and acquisitions.

deliverables: Project Management using hybrid Agile and waterfall methodologies
Migration planning and aligning to tool requirements
Office365 Tenant Creation and Domain planning
Exchange Mailbox & Resource Migration & Cutover Process
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Map to ISO:27001 and NIST
Provide guidance and governance for Access Control Program for Microsoft Exchange Mail System
Coordinated Exchange migration requirements with key users, IT staff, and management
Migration Review and end user documentation

outcomes: ✅ Project Management using hybrid Agile and waterfall methodologies
✅ Migration planning and aligning to tool requirements
